messages:
Anya: kicking off "regionally-scoped burst pools" proposal. objective: let customers reserve regional headroom and enable local short bursts without touching global capacity.
Marcos: 👍 lowers p99 for region-sensitive apps. main tradeoff is billing & UX complexity.
Priya: propose default single commit with admin-set regional allocation; enterprise can buy per-region commits. simple slider in dashboard.
Sam: runtime note: allocator should prefer local nodes; only spillover if latency budget allows. add TTL-based fallback and spillover_limit percent.
BillingBot: sample invoice lines (mock): reserved_commit USD 6,000/mo; eu_burst_minutes 90 -> USD 45; cross_region_spill 1500 tokens -> USD 1.5.
Lina: sales ask: FinPay wants 5s bursts at 8k tps in EU. can we support microburst path?
Sam: yes but treat as microburst: avoid autoscale triggers, local ephemeral prewarm. require ops review for >4k tps in pilot.
Marcos: action: traffic replay for three customer shapes (chat, ingest, mixed). knobs: burst_window, tokens_per_sec, spillover_limit_ms.
Priya: MVP scope: region-prefer routing, per-region meter + invoice line, dashboard slider + API, basic spillover (reject or best-effort). exclude cross-region autoscale for MVP.
Sam: config proto:
```
route: "/reconcile"
region_policy:
  prefer: eu-west-1
  spillover_limit_percent: 20
  microburst:
    enabled: true
    window_ms: 5000
    tokens_per_sec: 8000
cooldown_seconds: 180
```
Marcos: risk notes: billing confusion, routing complexity, autoscaler thrash. mitigations: clear invoice names, TTL fallbacks, 180s regional cooldown.
Anya: launch checklist: canary runtime, simulation report <5% p99 impact for others, staging invoices, dashboard UI, ops runbook.
OpsBot: canary scheduled 2026-05-10T14:00Z.
Lina: I'll recruit 2 pilots.
Anya: no blockers. sync Thu 11:00 for sims.
